stem: Which sentence suggests that catching crabs is a popular activity on the beach?

options.label: F
options.text: A seasoned crab chaser, Hallie only holds them in her partially sand-filled bucket overnight.

options.label: G
options.text: Operating on pure fight-or-flight instinct, the crabs don't realize it's all just a game when a kid is on their trail.

options.label: H
options.text: It's the seaside version of catching fireflies and putting them in a jar, except that the crabs are bigger than bugs, about the size of a small child's fist.

options.label: J
options.text: When ghost crabs spot something threatening or bigger than they are—like a little girl with a flashlight and a green plastic bucket with a yellow handle—their eight legs can propel them up to speeds of 10 mph.
